dedupe_keys.name: ramboll co2mpare open access database of building carbon assessments

description: CO2mpare is Ramboll's open access database of carbon assessments of buildings, shared by the engineering firm with industry and governments to support benchmarking of emissions from construction. The page read on 2026-09-28 says the database holds more than 300 assessments across 13 building typologies and 12 combinations of life-cycle scopes, drawn from different assessment methodologies used on Ramboll's design projects, and offers an interactive benchmarking viewer to compare typical carbon for projects by country, typology and project type; most data are from Europe and the database is described as work in progress. Coverage is international with a European focus. Access is free through the web viewer; no licence or bulk download is stated. Caveats: assessments follow different methods and scopes, sample sizes per type are small, and the data describe one firm's portfolio. It supports embodied carbon inputs for building stock and retrofit scenarios, such as comparing reconstruction options after damage. Related records: data-clf-wblca-benchmark-study-v2 is a comparable whole-building life cycle benchmark.
